title: Camp Andrews

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: At Camp Andrews, we want to provide every child a place to escape these distractions and instead experience Christ, nature, and positive human connections. Our summer camp facilities are open for church groups to bring groups of children and youth for a week so they can experience Christ in a way that makes them want to continue seeking Him. Our facility is surrounded by nature, a beautiful creek, and plenty of natural walking trails where children can enjoy nature.
